headline: Five Kotlin engineering concerns, sixteen focused checks, zero failures.
claim: Codeclew can provide decision-ready, freshness-bound Kotlin evidence instead of only lexical locations.

concerns.title: Compatibility decisions are typed
concerns.fact: An absent project/engine row returns REJECTED with PROJECT_ENGINE_ROW_NOT_QUALIFIED before analysis is admitted.

concerns.title: Unicode coordinates share one byte domain
concerns.fact: Top-level and nested relation positions are converted from compiler UTF-16 offsets to UTF-8 byte ranges and fail closed on invalid positions.
concerns.code:
val byteRange = coordinates.range(start, end) ?: return null
normalized += rebuild(argument, mapOf(
    "argumentStart" to JsonPrimitive(byteRange.first),
    "argumentEnd" to JsonPrimitive(byteRange.last + 1),
))

concerns.title: Maven reactor selection stays inside the repository
concerns.fact: Escaping, absent and ambiguous reactor modules become typed UNSUPPORTED_PROJECT_CONFIGURATION failures.

concerns.title: Oversized CFGs become explicit boundaries
concerns.fact: A local compiler graph above 4,096 nodes or 8,192 edges returns LOCAL_CFG_BUDGET_EXCEEDED rather than an unbounded payload.

concerns.title: Semantic input authority is canonical
concerns.fact: A stale semanticInputManifestHash is removed, the canonical manifest is hashed, and one fresh SHA-256 authority is attached.
concerns.code:
val manifest = unhashed["semanticInputManifest"] ?: unhashed
val digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
    .digest(canonicalSemanticJson(manifest).toByteArray())
...
put("semanticInputManifestHash", digest)
